questions.content: Please tell us your age.

result.content:
The safety of our patients is our top priority. Unfortunately, as hair loss under the age of 18 could be a sign of an underlying condition, we’re unable to recommend a hair loss treatment for you. Please contact your doctor for advice.

If you’d like to talk to our clinicians about this, please email clinic@numan.com and we’ll do our best to find a solution or recommend next steps.

questions.content: What kind of hair loss do you have?

result.content:
Defined circular areas of hair loss on the head may suggest a form of alopecia, therefore it is best to consult your GP so they can investigate.

If you’d like to talk to our clinicians about this, please email clinic@numan.com and we’ll do our best to find a solution or recommend next steps.

Our treatments are not effective in individuals who have experienced complete hair loss.

If you’d like to talk to our clinicians about this, please email clinic@numan.com and we’ll do our best to find a solution or recommend next steps.

result.query_clinically: Hair loss of this nature may be caused by underlying medical conditions which may require further investigation. questions.content:
Please tell us about your hair loss:
  • can you describe the appearance of your hair loss
  • do you have a diagnosis for your hair loss?
  • for how long has it occurred?
  • has anything made it better or worse, such as stress?
  • do you have any other symptoms?
This information is needed so that our clinicians can ensure the prescription is safe for you to take.

options.content: Over the last few days or weeks

result.content:
The safety of our patients is our top priority. Unfortunately, our treatments are not suitable for you because they are not designed for sudden hair loss. Sudden hair loss can have a number of causes and we recommend you seek advice from your usual GP to investigate causes for your sudden hair loss.

If you’d like to talk to our clinicians about this, please email clinic@numan.com and we’ll do our best to find a solution or recommend next steps.
